title: Demo report download builds a 404 URL — analysis-id → application-id mapping drops the wrong characters
evidence: demo_api.gleam:521-527: `let application_id = string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3)` ... `let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf"`. demo_store.gleam:197: analysis id is `"an-aoife"`, and pages/application_detail.gleam:674 passes `analysis.id` to `UserClickedDownloadReport`. `string.drop_start("an-aoife", 3)` yields `"aoife"`, not `"a-aoife"`. server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:481: `let out_path = out_dir <> "/report-" <> p.application_id <> ".pdf"` — and `ls server/priv/static/demo/` shows only `report-a-aoife.pdf`, `report-a-conor.pdf`, etc. The same wrong value also keys `demo_store.report_filenames()` (keys are `"a-aoife"`...), so the filename lookup never matches either.
detail: Every demo report download fetches /static/demo/report-aoife.pdf (etc.), which does not exist; map_pdf_result turns the 404 into an error toast. Acceptance pillar 'downloadable mock reports' is broken for all 8 pre-baked PDFs.
recommended_fix: Compute the application id as `"a-" <> string.drop_start(analysis_id, 3)` (or `"a" <> string.drop_start(analysis_id, 2)`) so 'an-aoife' maps to 'a-aoife'.

title: Six of nine demo analytics events are never fired — surface-open and report-download tracking is defined but not wired
evidence: demo_analytics.gleam:38-50 define `pub const demo_vacancy_open`, `demo_application_open`, `demo_comparison_open`, `demo_archived_open`, `demo_report_download`, `demo_create_vacancy_open`. A grep for those names across client/src and client/test returns matches only in demo_analytics.gleam itself; the only wired events are `demo_entry` (client.gleam:5701), `demo_reset` (demo_update.gleam:72,477) and `demo_cta_click` (demo_update.gleam:66).
detail: The spec acceptance (briefing deliverable 7) and PR body promise PostHog capture of 'entry, key surfaces, downloads, CTA clicks'; only entry/reset/CTA actually fire, so conversion analysis of the demo funnel loses surface and download signals.
recommended_fix: Fire demo_vacancy_open / demo_application_open / demo_comparison_open / demo_archived_open / demo_report_download / demo_create_vacancy_open at the corresponding demo_update arms (e.g. AppRequestedVacancyDetail, AppRequestedApplicationDetail, UserClickedDownloadReport) or drop the unused constants.

title: Orphan exports: decode_checked, all_fixture_jsons, result_to_seed_error, demo_store.notifications/1, capture_with_props are never called
evidence: demo_fixtures.gleam:127 `pub fn decode_checked(`, :143 `pub fn all_fixture_jsons()`, :199 `pub fn result_to_seed_error(`, demo_store.gleam:1384 `pub fn notifications(store: DemoStore) -> List(Notification)`, demo_analytics.gleam:23 `pub fn capture_with_props(`. Greps across client/src and client/test show no callers; the conformance suite (test/demo/fixtures_conformance_test.gleam:21-41) calls only `demo_fixtures.seed_landlord/seed_notifications/seed_vacancies/seed_applications` directly.
detail: Dead public API surface. all_fixture_jsons' doc comment claims it 'exists so the test can enumerate them', but the test never uses it — misleading documentation plus maintenance weight.
recommended_fix: Delete the five unused functions, or rewire fixtures_conformance_test.gleam to enumerate via all_fixture_jsons/decode_checked as the doc comment describes.

title: download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam
evidence: demo_update.gleam:562 `fn download_timeout(id: String) -> Effect(Msg) { effect.from(fn(dispatch) { global.set_timeout(90_000, fn() { dispatch(msg.AppTimedOutDownloadReport(id)) }) ...` duplicates client.gleam:6693 `fn download_timeout(analysis_id: String, delay_ms: Int) -> Effect(Msg) { effect.from(fn(dispatch) { global.set_timeout(delay_ms, fn() { dispatch(AppTimedOutDownloadReport(analysis_id)) }) ...`, called at client.gleam:3134 as `download_timeout(id, 90_000)`.
detail: Same effect logic in two places with the timeout literal hardcoded in the demo copy; a future change to the timeout or message shape must be made twice (DRY rule: extract when logic repeats 2+ places).
recommended_fix: Make client.gleam's download_timeout/2 public (or move it to a shared helper module) and call it from demo_update with 90_000 instead of re-implementing it.

title: Demo refcheck 'start' maps to Scheduled — a status the codebase documents as v2-reserved (voice)
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1366 `"start" -> ReferenceCallDetail(..call, status: Scheduled)`. shared/src/shared/reference_call.gleam:17-24: `pub type ReferenceCallStatus { Queued Skipped ContactInitiated AwaitingCorrection /// v2-reserved (voice) Scheduled ...`, and server/src/reference_checks/sql.gleam:72 documents the real flow around 'contact_initiated' ('Guarded submit transition (AD-14): only from \'contact_initiated\'').
detail: The real v1 manual-start flow moves a call to contact_initiated; the demo instead surfaces Scheduled, a v2-reserved voice status the production product never produces — the demo shows a panel state real users will never see.
recommended_fix: Map the demo 'start' action to ContactInitiated (mirroring the real manual-start transition) instead of Scheduled.

title: Demo UserClickedNotification arm doesn't close the notification dropdown (real handler does)
evidence: demo_update.gleam:382-386: `UserClickedNotification(id, _entity_type, _entity_id) -> { let store = store_of(model) ... #(Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next)), eff) }` — no show_notification_dropdown update. The real handler (client.gleam:4318) ends with `#(Model(..model, show_notification_dropdown: False), effect.batch([navigate_eff, mark_eff]))`.
detail: In demo mode clicking a notification marks it read but leaves the dropdown open, diverging from the live UI the demo is supposed to mirror.
recommended_fix: Set show_notification_dropdown: False in the demo arm's returned Model to match the real handler.
